question: When German league matches were played in empty stadiums in 2020, what changed about yellow cards?
answer: Away teams were booked less. With crowds, visitors had received about 0.3 more yellow cards a match than hosts. Without fans, cards to the home side barely moved, while cards to the away side fell by about 0.3. The crowd had not been protecting its own team; it had been pointing at the other one.
move: Before deciding who a bias helped, find out whom it was aimed at.
trap: Assuming referees had favoured the home side, so hosts would pay.
